notes: Choir: crystal singers of the Lumen chantry (standard rig). A hollow resonant body of lilac crystal shaped like a violin's: two f-holes, a round dark rose hole, a gold bridge and tailpiece; a ring of 11 gold tuning forks stands round the shoulders like a halo (the back ones are under the body). Crystal limbs with gold rings and three-fingered hands, forked crystal feet. torso_glow (2 frames, ~2 fps) is the resonance light in the rose hole, the f-holes and the fork tips; head_glow lights the singer's open mouth. Head variants: singer (bare crystal, a round open mouth), mitre (a chantry mitre, tinted), helmet (a glass dome with a brass rim). Outfit mask = the stole, the collar, the cuff ring-bands are gold (not tinted), the mitre. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 2 fps
